landing.title: PayFlow
landing.subtitle: Financial flows made simple for schools and families
landing.description: Centralize tuition, events and one-off charges in one place, with clear communication between school and guardians.

problem.title: Spreadsheets, WhatsApp and scattered receipts don't scale
problem.spreadsheets: Manual spreadsheets, different versions and a risk of errors on every update.
problem.whatsapp: Payment requests get lost among groups, chats and off-hours messages.
problem.receipts: Receipts spread across email, photos and attachments make reconciliation hard.

solution.title: A platform designed for school operations
solution.events: Events: registrations, payments and attendance in a single flow.
solution.tuitions: Tuitions: automatic billing, invoices and delinquency tracking.
solution.oneOff: One-off charges: materials, trips and extras with less friction.
solution.communication: Communication: clear reminders for guardians, without the noise.
solution.finance: Finance and reports: consolidated view by class, grade and period.

proof.title: Built for schools that want professional financial workflows
proof.subtitle: Testimonials, case studies and integrations will live here — for now, focus on validating the flow.

finalCta.title: Ready to organize your school payments?
finalCta.subtitle: Start with a small group of guardians and evolve safely.
